summary: Suspected dependency-confusion placeholder with inert webhook.site beacon reference
details: css-grid-snap-util@1.0.1 ships a stub index.js that returns a static object and declares no install lifecycle hooks. The tarball additionally includes a JSON manifest containing a `baseURL` field pointing at a webhook.site unique collector endpoint (https://webhook.site/633e0d27-3407-4b73-a242-1ecd1f6edcb8/bundles/). No code in the package reads this file, transmits data, or fetches remote content, so installing or requiring the package does not currently execute any outbound behavior. The combination of a thin stub module, an unused manifest referencing a known beacon host, and a generic name reminiscent of internal utility packages fits the shape of a dependency-confusion placeholder or proof-of-concept rather than a functional library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
